query_normalized: investigating correlations between molecular descriptors and drug-likeness scores chemistry
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) because it explicitly builds Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) models that associate molecular structures (descriptors) with ADMET properties, which are the core components of "drug-likeness" scores. Even though the paper focuses on a specific AutoML methodology, it provides direct evidence of the mechanism linking molecular descriptors to drug-relevant properties, making it a canonical reference for the domain.
